job.title: Regional Commercial Manager
job.description:
Regional Commercial Manager | Data Centers | Southeast Asia
  
Our client is a specialist contractor serving the data center market across Asia. They’re looking for a Regional Commercial Manager to oversee the commercial performance of multiple data center projects across Southeast Asia, taking responsibility for cost management, contracts and project profitability across the regional portfolio.

This role calls for someone with a strong grounding in quantity surveying and cost management, backed by substantial commercial and contracts experience. You’ll take responsibility for profitability across the regional portfolio, support project commercial teams, and lead negotiations on major contracts and commercial issues.

You’ll need to be comfortable challenging a cost forecast in detail, then stepping back to advise senior management on the region’s wider commercial position.

The Role
You’ll oversee the commercial lifecycle across multiple concurrent projects, from tender review and subcontract procurement through delivery to final account settlement. Working closely with pre-construction and project leadership, you’ll make sure each project has a sound commercial strategy and that risks are identified and addressed early.

A key part of the role will be setting clear standards for project teams, strengthening cost control, and giving senior management an accurate view of performance across the region.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Taking regional responsibility for project commercial performance, including margins, cash flow and financial exposure.
  • Leading and supporting QS and commercial teams across multiple projects, reviewing forecasts and challenging assumptions where needed.
  • Overseeing cost planning, CVR reporting and cost-to-complete forecasts, with clear reporting at both project and regional level.
  • Leading commercial and contractual reviews of tenders, main contracts and key subcontracts, ensuring obligations and risks are understood before commitments are made.
  • Setting procurement strategies and supporting negotiations with specialist subcontractors and suppliers.
  • Overseeing contract administration, including notices, variations, claims and extensions of time, through to final account agreement.
  • Acting as the senior commercial contact for clients and delivery partners, leading negotiations and resolving escalated commercial issues.
  • Working with pre-construction teams to test pricing assumptions and ensure bids reflect delivery requirements and contractual risk.
  • Improving commercial procedures and reporting consistency across Southeast Asia.
What You Bring
  • A strong QS and cost management foundation, with 12+ years of relevant construction experience and at least 5 years in a senior commercial management or leadership role.
  • A track record of overseeing the commercial performance of multiple major projects, ideally across Southeast Asia.
  • Significant experience in data centers, mission-critical construction or complex MEP projects, with a good understanding of technical fit-out and white space delivery.
  • Strong commercial and contracts experience, including contract negotiation, administration and the resolution of claims or disputes.
  • Detailed knowledge of cost control and forecasting, with the ability to interrogate project accounts and identify financial exposure early.
  • Experience leading QS or commercial teams and working confidently with senior client representatives and internal directors.
  • A degree in Quantity Surveying or a related discipline. MRICS or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
  • The judgement to balance commercial protection with practical project delivery, and the confidence to challenge decisions when profitability is at risk.
Contact me via email at ben@mcr.agency for more information.

job.title: Regional M&E Project Manager
job.description:

Certified Data Centre Project Manager (CDCPM) certification or equivalent proven data centre project experience is desirable.

Apply with your CV, highlighting your relevant project delivery experience.

job.title: Operations Manager
job.description:
We are looking to hire an experienced operations manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of a mission-critical datacentre project in Batam, Indonesia.
 
The role will lead site operations, ensuring the facility operates safely, reliably and efficiently 24/7. You will manage technical teams, critical M&E infrastructure, maintenance, incidents, vendors and operational standards.
 
What you'll be doing
  • Lead day-to-day 24/7 data centre operations and site teams.
  • Manage critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure including UPS, generators, power distribution, cooling and BMS/DCIM.
  • Lead engineers, technicians and shift teams.
  • Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance activities.
  • Manage incidents, equipment failures, escalation and root cause analysis.
  • Review and maintain SOPs, MOPs and EOPs.
  • Manage vendors, contractors and maintenance partners.
  • Ensure compliance with safety, operational and customer requirements.
  • Support projects, upgrades, commissioning and handover into operations.
  • Drive operational improvements, reliability and efficiency.
What we are looking for
  • Degree/Diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, Facilities or related engineering discipline.
  • 8 + years' experience in datacentres, critical facilities or mission-critical environments.
  • At least 3-5 years of direct datacentre operations experience.
  • Strong understanding of critical electrical and mechanical systems.
  • Experience managing technical teams, contractors and vendors.
  • Strong knowledge of SOP/MOP/EOP, incident and change management.
  • Experience operating live, high-availability environments.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.

job.title: Commissioning Lead
job.description:
An Australian-founded datacenter commissioning specialist is looking for a Commissioning Lead to help develop its Malaysian operation.

The business already has a team delivering work in Malaysia. As it expands, it needs someone who can spend time with engineers on site, maintain high technical and delivery standards, and work closely with senior leadership on the next stage of growth.

This could suit an experienced Commissioning Manager ready for wider responsibility, or a technical leader who also brings the ability to develop client relationships and support business growth.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Oversee commissioning delivery across the Malaysian operation as its project portfolio grows.
  • Provide technical leadership across electrical, mechanical, HVAC, controls and other critical datacenter systems.
  • Lead commissioning activities from commissioning planning and pre-functional testing through final handover.
  • Work closely with engineers and commissioning teams on site to troubleshoot technical issues and resolve commissioning deficiencies.
  • Support engineers in managing challenging site situations and provide practical technical guidance when issues arise.
  • Work closely with clients, consultants, contractors, vendors and project teams throughout commissioning and handover.
  • Support the development and mentoring of engineers, helping build a strong local commissioning capability.
  • Work with senior leadership on team development, resource planning and the future direction of the Malaysian operation.
For someone with the right commercial experience, the remit could also include business development, client relationship management and wider operational responsibility.

What we are looking for:
  • Electrical or Mechanical Engineering background, with relevant technical qualifications and experience within datacentre or mission-critical environments.
  • Proven experience leading commissioning delivery on datacentre or mission-critical projects.
  • Experience leading engineers, commissioning teams, contractors and specialist vendors.
  • Confidence working directly with clients, consultants and project stakeholders.
  • Previous Asian / APAC project experience would be useful, although candidates relocating to the region will also be considered.
  • A willingness to work predominantly on site and travel as required across Malaysia.
  • Johor Bahru is the preferred base, with regular attendance on project sites. 
  • Commitment to living and working in Malaysia is an important part of the opportunity.
Candidates currently based overseas who are seriously considering relocation to Malaysia will also be considered.

Why Consider It?
  • You will have close access to senior leadership and the opportunity to build on an existing Malaysian presence.
  • The role offers scope to influence delivery standards and develop engineers, with responsibilities shaped around your strengths and the needs of the business. 
  • Package details and relocation arrangements will be discussed individually. 
  • To discuss the opportunity in confidence, share your CV and a brief overview of the commissioning projects you have led, your preferred location and your availability.

job.title: Commissioning Engineer - Data Centre Projects

Join one of the fastest-growing sectors in construction. We’re looking for an experienced Commissioning Engineer to deliver Data Centre projects across Melbourne.

As a Commissioning Engineer, you’ll be responsible for driving the commissioning process from installation through to integrated systems testing and handover.

You’ll work closely with the project team, consultants, subcontractors, vendors and client to ensure all building services are fully tested, commissioned and ready for operation.

You’ll be responsible for:
  • Developing and managing commissioning plans and programmes.
  • Managing pre-commissioning, functional testing and integrated systems testing.
  • Reviewing commissioning documentation.
  • Coordinating subcontractors, vendors, consultants and specialist commissioning agents.
  • Identifying and resolving defects and commissioning issues.
  • Managing testing schedules and ensuring commissioning milestones are achieved.
  • Supporting client witnessing, demonstrations and final handover.
  • Maintaining detailed commissioning records and documentation.
About you:
  • Experience commissioning technically complex building services (MEP) projects.
  • Tertiary qualifications in Mechanical or Electrical (or Trade qualified).
  • Experience with functional performance testing and integrated systems testing.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • A methodical, detail-focused approach to testing and documentation.
  • Confidence to coordinate multiple contractors and stakeholders in a live construction environment.
  • Full working rights in Australia.
If you're a Commissioning Engineer looking to take your career into Data Centres and mission-critical construction, this is an opportunity to get involved in some of Melbourne's most exciting projects.

  • Participate in testing and commissioning of critical electrical systems.
  • Work with consultants, contractors and specialist vendors to resolve technical issues and deliver project requirements.
  • Contribute to design optimisation, value engineering and energy-efficiency initiatives.
  • Develop technical standards, engineering specifications and O&M documentation.
What We're Looking For
  • 8+ years of electrical engineering experience, with strong experience in data centres, mission-critical facilities or other high-reliability environments.
  • Strong electrical design engineering background with experience across the project lifecycle.
  • Solid knowledge of HV/MV/LV electrical distribution systems.
  • Experience with UPS, generators, transformers, switchgear, busway/busduct and critical power systems.
  • Strong understanding of electrical load calculations, equipment sizing, protection and power distribution.
  • Experience reviewing consultant and contractor designs and technical submissions.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 10–30% across APAC, particularly during project delivery phases.

job.title: Mechanical Engineering Lead
job.description:
The Engineering Lead (Mechanical) will serve as the key mechanical  engineering authority for our datacenter platform. As an individual contributor, you will provide technical leadership across the full project lifecycle, from site selection and engineering design through construction, commissioning, and operations.

The role will work closely with internal teams, consultants, contractors, and clients to develop practical, reliable, and technically sound solutions that support project delivery and meet customer requirements.

What you'll do
  • Provide mechanical engineering input during site evaluation and acquisition activities.
  • Identify potential engineering risks, constraints, and development requirements.
  • Review engineering designs and technical submissions to ensure quality, compliance, and alignment with project requirements.
  • Provide technical support throughout construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.
  • Support project teams in troubleshooting and resolving mechanical and infrastructure-related issues.
  • Work collaboratively with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, vendors, and clients.
  • Lead technical discussions, design reviews, coordination meetings, and engineering workshops.

  • Strong mechanical engineering knowledge with excellent technical coordination and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

You will provide technical leadership and engineering expertise across the complete project lifecycle — from site selection and technical due diligence through design, construction, commissioning, and operations.

The role will work closely with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, utility providers, and clients to develop robust, reliable, and scalable electrical solutions that support successful project delivery and meet operational and customer requirements.

What you'll do
  • Review technical studies, assessments, and due diligence reports.
  • Identify key risks, constraints, and development considerations related to electrical infrastructure.
  • Coordinate electrical engineering activities across design, solutioning, construction, and commissioning.
  • Manage technical issues, changes, and project risks.
  • Ensure solutions meet operational, reliability, and business requirements.
  • Provide technical advice to project teams during construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.
  • Assist with troubleshooting and resolution of electrical and critical power infrastructure issues.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, consultants, contractors, utility providers, and vendors.
  • Monitor project progress and communicate technical risks and issues.
  • Drive innovation, process improvements, standardisation, and capture lessons learned.
What you'll need
  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • 5-10 years of experience in data centres, critical infrastructure, construction, power systems, or engineering environments.
  • Experience supporting projects through design, construction, commissioning, and operations.
  • Knowledge of critical electrical systems, including utility power, switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, generators, and power distribution systems.
  • Strong technical coordination, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
